correction.defect: Floating linspace calibration boundaries could omit a prediction numerically adjacent to an exact decimal boundary such as 0.60 from every ECE bin.
correction.fix: Map every finite clipped probability to exactly one integer bin with min(int(probability * 10), 9).

selection_implementation.calibration: Correction scale is selected on calibration only after the fitted correction and feature view are fixed.
selection_implementation.family_choice: At most one probability candidate is selected on the selection partition; after-cost economics remain mandatory and unevaluated.
selection_implementation.l2_penalty: Five declared penalties are compared with five expanding whole-condition training folds and a 600000 ms pre-validation embargo.
selection_implementation.matched_ablation: Base and augmented candidates use identical rows, targets, condition weights, market-prior offsets, and selection observations.
selection_implementation.persistence: Full model payloads and canonical identities are embedded in the selection claim and reconstructed fail closed.
selection_implementation.uncertainty: Time-ordered condition-level stationary bootstrap intervals compare augmented versus base and augmented versus market prior.
